title: Key term
definition: Weighing evidence and reasoning to reach a judgement you can justify, rather than describing or accepting a claim at face value.
extendedDefinition: At university, being critical means testing a claim against the evidence and reasoning behind it: asking how a source knows what it claims, where that holds, and where it does not.
example: Rather than writing "Smith (2020) shows remote work boosts productivity", a critical writer asks how Smith measured productivity, and for whom.
